interest: Empress Nagako's plan to educate Akihito in America and England.
overview: Butterworth's February 17, 1949 memo on Empress Nagako's proposal to educate Crown Prince Akihito in America and England.

subfiles.about: A State Department memorandum reporting an informal suggestion by the Japanese Empress to educate the Crown Prince in the United States and England, and detailing General MacArthur's recommendations.
subfiles.summary: Butterworth reports Sebald's letter on the Empress's idea of U.S. prep school and English university for the Crown Prince; MacArthur preferred English first and a U.S. college.
subfiles.title: Office Memorandum from FE - Mr. Butterworth to The Secretary on Education of Japanese Crown Prince in the United States and England
